newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up in sessions dominated by banks.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up in sessions dominated by banks.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 29 Reuter - Colombian stocks edged up in sessions dominated by dealing in the country's two major banks.
Bogota's IBB index was up 0.24 percent to 1,135.08 amid a 1.7 billion volume while Medellin's IBOMED general price index was up 0.1 percent to 17,342.6 amid a 7 billion peso volume.

"I don't see any clear trend in Colombian stocks nor in the economy in general. They say there are foundations for growth but I can't see that," said Juan Gomez, of the Profesionales de Bolsa de Medellin brokerage.

Ordinary shares in Banco Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets, were up 0.84 percent to 358 in Bogota and up 1.42 percent to the same price in Medellin. The bank's preferential shares 4.32 percent to the same price in Medellin.

Markets had closed before the bank posted a 0.8 percent drop in first-quarter net profits amid increased personnel and general running costs. Colombia's second largest bank, Banco de Colombia dipped 0.51 percent to 383 in Bogota and lost 0.26 percent to 384 in Medellin.
A third bank, Banco Bancoquia, the financial arm of the Santo Domingo industrial conglomerate, was up 1.01 percent to 3,000 in Bogota and up 3.45 percent to the same price in Medellin.
"There's greater investor confidence that the deal with Spain's Banco Santander is about to be tied up," a Bogota broker said.

Earlier this week, Augusto Lopez ,chairman of Bavaria the flagship of the Santo Domingo group, said it was possible a deal would be signed this week which would see the Spanish bank take 51 percent of Bancoquia.
Brewing giant Bavaria dipped 0.26 percent to 7,899 and by 0.14 percent to the same price in Medellin.
